support.forward_path: motor case shoulder -> mica sector pads -> fixed G11 thrust plate or TVC integral G11 stop -> rails -> fixed shell joints or radial screws into inner gimbal -> pivots/frame
support.reverse_path: motor case aft closure -> retainer/cap -> three M3 blocks/bolts -> fixed frame or TVC cassette

channel_net_section.method: Rail cross-section rectangle minus the intersecting fin-channel rectangle. This ideal net section omits notch-root concentration and local plate/rail restraint.

rails.method: Equal forward load share over 3 configured load-bearing rail(s); weakest net rectangular-axis Euler column. Fixed mount uses configured ring stations as lateral supports. TVC cassette assumes rail support at the integral fore stop, grip collar and aft blocks; the longest inter-support span governs. Actual rail restraint is uncertain.

thrust_plate_and_pads.method: Independent radial sector-strip cantilevers from pad edge to outer radius; circumferential ring action omitted. Active pad count reflects the stated support geometry assumption. The fixed notched-slot result is a footprint-average pressure only, not a verified bearing contact area; actual sidewall/base contact and local stress require resolved contact geometry.

reverse_retainer.method: Equal load share across configured blocks/bolts. Nominal M3 tensile area is a bolt-demand indicator only. Fixed-mode captive-nut pockets are assumed from CAD; nut grade/retention and plywood block bearing are unverified. TVC G11 tapped-thread stripping uses a simple cylindrical shear-area hypothesis. Washer bearing, pocket breakout, block splitting, edge distance and eccentricity are unverified.

fixed_mount_bond_proxy.method: A single 360-degree bond around the last mount ring is assumed; neither bond gap/land nor actual plywood-to-shell joint is modeled as a verified connection.

fixed_thrust_plate_bond_sensitivities.method: Fixed six-finger estimate uses clipped radial contact width times 18 mm axial finger length for each slot flank, and a full circumferential plate OD bond over 9 mm web thickness. Adhesive geometry is not modeled; 0.2 mm flank gaps, peel, termination, wetting, cure and actual load split remain unresolved. Uniform-shear sensitivity only.

unresolved: Exact motor case front shoulder/nozzle 24 mm opening geometry and closure capture are supplier dependencies.
Properties are preliminary estimates, not material or joint allowables; no physical proof test is represented.
Contact, local stress concentrations, manufacturing tolerances and assembly preload are not solved.

rails.method: Equal forward load share over 2 configured load-bearing rail(s); weakest net rectangular-axis Euler column. Fixed mount uses configured ring stations as lateral supports. TVC cassette assumes rail support at the integral fore stop, grip collar and aft blocks; the longest inter-support span governs. Actual rail restraint is uncertain.

pin_sets.method: Each opposed pin shares one half of axial thrust. Shear stress is reported for single and double shear. Bending treats radial clearance as a conservative simply-overhung gap (M=Fpin*g/2). The bore is radial through the concentric ring wall; projected bearing length is radial wall (Ro−Ri), and axial edge ligament is (6 mm axial thickness−3.4 mm bore)/2. Bore center lies at z=t/2 in CAD. Pin material strength, positive axial retention, hot load capacity and contact remain unverified.

Each opposed pin shares one half of axial thrust. Shear stress is reported for single and double shear. Bending treats radial clearance as a conservative simply-overhung gap (M=Fpin*g/2). The bore is radial through the concentric ring wall; projected bearing length is radial wall (Ro−Ri), and axial edge ligament is (6 mm axial thickness−3.4 mm bore)/2. Bore center lies at z=t/2 in CAD. Pin material strength, positive axial retention, hot load capacity and contact remain unverified.

thrust_plate_and_pads.method: Independent radial sector-strip cantilevers from pad edge to outer radius; circumferential ring action omitted. Active pad count reflects the stated support geometry assumption. The fixed notched-slot result is a footprint-average pressure only, not a verified bearing contact area; actual sidewall/base contact and local stress require resolved contact geometry. The rod relief is a partial annular cut; this is not a full-ring pass and does not resolve load redistribution or local stress at the relief edge.

reverse_retainer.method: Equal load share across configured blocks/bolts. Nominal M3 tensile area is a bolt-demand indicator only. Fixed-mode captive-nut pockets are assumed from CAD; nut grade/retention and plywood block bearing are unverified. TVC G11 tapped-thread stripping uses a simple cylindrical shear-area hypothesis. Washer bearing, pocket breakout, block splitting, edge distance and eccentricity are unverified.

TVC_radial_screw_bearing.method: Three radial screws share axial load equally. Gross shank single-shear and an upper-bound G11 projected bearing screen use configured screw-hole depth as engagement. Actual shear planes, wall thickness, thread stripping, countersink and gimbal ligaments require detailed geometry and fastener data; no screw strength capacity is assigned.

limitations: Pinned spans require real ring/frame restraint; exact shell/bond/brace flexibility and imperfect support are not proved.
Column sections include actual cylinder trimming. Rings, foreplate, pins, bonds and retention retain their individual screening limitations in support output.
Extreme-fibre distance is the centroid to the most distant bounding-box corner, bounding any principal bending direction; eccentricity and equal rail load share are assumptions.
No new FEA or physical test is claimed by this analytical check.
